svg.title: Mochaa (naichii) — a Frieren-themed travel journal
svg.desc: A Frieren-themed profile for Mochaa, a versatile software engineer, written as a travel journal that heads north, illustrated with official art (©K.Y.T.A/S/FP). Chapter 1, After the Journey's End: name, class, craft (web development and workflow automation), spec-driven development, open to collaboration, beside the official visual of Himmel and Frieren crowned with blue-moon weed, petals lifting off his hand. Chapter 2, Memories Along the Road, over the official journey map: the current full-stack role and its quests beside a still of the party heading into snowy peaks, then flashbacks of past roles back to computer engineering, numbered like the stops on the map. Chapter 3, A Chest in the Dungeon: the open-source side quest ai-engineering-starter, the official visual of Frieren head first in a mimic, an Episode 23 still of Fern pulling her out as Exhibit A, a tally of mimics against Frieren, and three magic circles from the series for chant the spec, cast the build, seal with review. Chapter 4, Useless Magic, Collected: the tech stack as six spells, each with its still from the official magic page (TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Python, React, Svelte, Astro, Express, Laravel, Elysia, Hono, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Node.js, Bun, Vite, npm, Composer, Git, Docker, Nginx). Chapter 5, Concealed Mana: GitHub activity with a 7 day current streak, a 15 day longest streak and 2233 contributions this year, a mana bar that shows only what a demon would read until Aura weighs it on her scale, and the year drawn as a field of blue-moon weed. Epilogue, To the North: links to X and GitHub beside an Episode 2 still of Himmel's statue that now and then fades into a memory of Himmel himself. Between chapters, the party's official chibi characters with captions in the series' time-skip style.

g.text: She found it after he was gone.
Fifty years on, a new journey begins.
“This time, I’ll get to know the people I build for.”
Frieren learned it at Himmel’s funeral. I’d rather learn it at kickoff.
since Aug 2026 · heading north, one quest at a time
kept the town crier on schedule
the first dungeon. As Eisen said, fear is what brought me this far
taught apprentices, as Flamme once taught Frieren
practised daily, like Fern, until the spell hit the distant rock
where the first seeds were planted
A short nap, by an elf’s count. Each stop meant more than it seemed.
Fern pulls her out every time.
Digs up exactly the rows you need.
Spell to keep shell out of a
Also inside: turning sweet grapes sour, and removing rust from bronze statues.
Fern doesn’t see the appeal. Frieren calls it a hobby. I ship with them.
Fern got her up by noon
Suppressed, as always. A demon would read this and guess wrong.
A year of blue-moon weed: one bloom for every day of work.
NORTHERN LANDS · 5 YEARS AFTER THE FIRST COMMIT
Himmel would have liked the view
Room for one more in your party?
Himmel had statues built so Frieren
wouldn’t be alone in the future.
I write documentation for the same reason.
(Need a hand? It’s what Himmel the Hero would have done.)
